Nudge: A Private Recommendations Engine
Three-party private matrix factorization protocol

rating vector u(i)
items user interacted with

public parameters
embedding d, iterations ℓ
ring Z₂ᵇ, fractional bits t

succinct secret sharing
via distributed point functions

servers hold replicated shares ⟦U⟧
no server sees rating locations or values

Matrix-vector program
alternate: matrix-vector multiply
and nonlinear vector functions

Power iteration
v ← Uᵀ(Uv)
SetOrthogonal(v,B)
Normalize(v)

recommendation scores
u(i) · BᵀB
returned as shares

Hidden from every single server
• which items each user rated
• rating values and positions
• intermediate private vectors

Allowed leakage
• final aggregate model B
• number of ratings per user
• submission timing metadata

Security limits
• semi-honest only
• not secure if ≥2 servers collude
• model may encode aggregate behavior
Evaluation anchor: Netflix 463K users / 17K items / 56M ratings  ·  private training 50 min over LAN  ·  40 GB server-to-server communication  ·  nDCG@20 = 0.29
